## 5. Detailed Project Catalog

### 5.1 Byakugan Scan
- **Portfolio URL**: https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/byakugan-scan
- **Official Website**: https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud
- **Support & Docs**: https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/support
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/byakugan-scan
- **Install via Homebrew**: `brew install --cask halcyon-past/tap/byakugan-scan`
- **Tech Stack**: Swift 6.0, AppKit, SwiftUI, Apple Vision Framework, Neural Engine, macOS 14+, Homebrew Cask
- **Overview**: Byakugan Scan is a native macOS menu bar utility for instant, in-memory screen OCR, QR code, and barcode recognition. Unlike conventional screenshot OCR tools that write temporary image files to `/tmp` and wake up macOS Spotlight (`mdwrite`) or `MADService` daemons, Byakugan Scan captures selected screen regions directly into `NSPasteboard` memory as a `CGImage` buffer and runs `VNRecognizeTextRequest` and `VNDetectBarcodesRequest` on the Apple Neural Engine in under 50ms—with zero temporary files, zero network calls, and zero external Swift package dependencies.
- **Key Features**:
  - Zero-Disk In-Memory Pipeline (`NSPasteboard` -> `CGImage` -> Neural Engine in <50ms).
  - 60/120Hz Custom AppKit Overlay (`SelectionOverlayController`) with theme accents (`Byakugan Violet`, `Tenseigan Cyan`, `Sharingan Crimson`, `Sage Emerald`, `Nine-Tails Amber`).
  - Multi-Language OCR across 13+ languages and barcode decoding (QR, MicroQR, EAN-8/13, UPC-E, Code 128/39/93, PDF417, Aztec, Data Matrix).
  - Frosted-glass Floating HUD pill with word/character counts and one-click `Open URL`, `Send Email`, and `Call` actions.
  - Deep-link automation via `byakugan://` URL scheme for Raycast, Alfred, and macOS Shortcuts, plus searchable local scan history.

### 5.2 OpenWorld Portfolio
- **Portfolio URL**: https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/openworld-portfolio
- **Live Demo**: https://openworld.aritro.cloud/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/openworld-portfolio
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5 Canvas 2D, Web Audio API, Web Speech API
- **Overview**: An interactive, retro Pokémon-inspired 2.5D open-world developer portfolio set in Pallet Cloud. Built completely from scratch without third-party game engines using Next.js 16, React 19, and native HTML5 Canvas 2D.
- **Key Features**:
  - Custom 2.5D Canvas Engine running at 60 FPS with Painter's algorithm depth sorting, elevation plateaus, and GBA-styled wild grass encounters.
  - Silicon Gym & Turn-Based Boss Battle against Gym Leader Aritro (Lv. 99) with 8 inspectable Gym Badges and a Master Ball recruit sequence.
  - Poké Mart Tech Stack shopping cart allowing recruiters to dispatch Pokémon airmail-styled skill requisitions.
  - Interactive landmarks (Mega Jumbotron TV, Innovation Pokédex Center, AI Research Lab, arcade minigames) and one-click Executive Recruiter Dossier toggle.

### 5.3 Quarantine (`quarantine-py`)
- **Portfolio URL**: https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/quarantine
- **PyPI Package**: https://pypi.org/project/quarantine-py/ (`pip install quarantine-py`)
- **Documentation**: https://quarantine-py.aritro.cloud
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/quarantine
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3.9+, PyPI, AsyncIO, CLI, Dead-Letter Queue, Fault Tolerance, Pytest
- **Overview**: An open-source, zero-dependency Python library that brings dead-letter queue resilience to regular loops and batch data pipelines. Isolates failing items atomically to disk (`.quarantine/`) with full tracebacks and execution state so long-running jobs never crash mid-run.
- **Key Features**:
  - `@quarantine` decorator for sync/async functions and `shield()` iterator wrapper.
  - Atomic on-disk isolation without external message brokers.
  - Surgical CLI replays (`quarantine retry`) and post-mortem `pdb` debugging (`quarantine debug`).
  - Circuit breakers (`halt_after`), sensitive field redaction, and local web observability UI.

### 5.4 Structurify
- **Portfolio URL**: https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/structurify
- **Live Demo**: https://structurify.aritro.cloud
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/Structurify
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 14, React, TailwindCSS, Firebase, FastAPI, Python, LangGraph, Google Gemini, Google Cloud Platform
- **Overview**: Event-driven B2B SaaS platform that transforms unstructured CSV and XLSX files into a standardized master schema using Google Gemini and a serverless fan-out architecture on GCP (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run workers, LangGraph map-reduce, Firestore live streaming).

### 5.5 Luffy Laser Dodge
- **Portfolio URL**: https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/luffy-laser-dodge
- **Live Demo**: https://onepiece.aritro.cloud/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/Luffy-Laser-Dodge
- **Tech Stack**: React, Vite, React Three Fiber, Three.js, MediaPipe AI, WebAssembly (WASM)
- **Overview**: Interactive browser-based 3D reflex game where players dodge laser beams in real time using physical head movements tracked via webcam with MediaPipe WASM and procedural bone animation in Three.js, running 100% locally in the browser.

### 5.6 GlideConnect
- **Portfolio URL**: https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/glide-connect
- **Research Paper**: https://ijirt.org/article?manuscript=180711
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/Glide-Connect
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3.9, MediaPipe, OpenCV, Google Gemini API, PyAutoGUI, PyCAW
- **Overview**: Touchless computer interface using real-time hand gesture recognition for cursor movement, clicks, and system volume/brightness control, paired with a voice assistant ("Krishna") powered by Google Gemini Flash for multimodal screenshot analysis.

## 6. Developer Arcade (`https://www.aritro.cloud/play`)

An interactive collection of browser games built natively in React:
1. **Developer Speed Test** (`/play/typing-test`) — Terminal-style WPM typing test featuring programming syntax and keywords.
2. **Data Pipeline Puzzle** (`/play/data-pipeline`) — Graph/grid logic puzzle connecting data nodes without crossing pipelines.
3. **Minimalist Snake** (`/play/snake`) — Python developer edition of Snake collecting tech stack icons.
4. **Sudoku** (`/play/sudoku`) — Classic logic-based number placement puzzle.
5. **Space Invaders** (`/play/space-invaders`) — Retro arcade shooter defending production servers from incoming bugs.
6. **Flappy Bird** (`/play/flappy-bird`) — Classic physics-based obstacle navigation game.
7. **Tic Tac Toe** (`/play/tictactoe`) — Play against an unbeatable Minimax AI agent.
